data = open('main.db-wal','rb').read()
# check header decode with key 0x42
h = bytes(b^0x42 for b in data[:32])
import struct
print('magic', hex(struct.unpack('>I',h[0:4])[0]))
print('version', struct.unpack('>I',h[4:8])[0])
print('pagesize', struct.unpack('>I',h[8:12])[0])
print('ckptseq', struct.unpack('>I',h[12:16])[0])
print('salt', h[16:24].hex())
print('csum', h[24:32].hex())
print('len', len(data), 'frames', (len(data)-32)/ (24+struct.unpack('>I',h[8:12])[0]))
"
